description: This file defines a custom Android View class that handles touch events to manipulate a drawable icon. It supports dragging and scaling gestures via a VersionedGestureDetector, updating the icon position and scale accordingly.

classes.description: A custom Android View for handling touch interactions including dragging and scaling of an icon.
